## What changed

Describe the behavior and files changed.

## Why

State the verified problem or requirement.

## Preservation check

- [ ] Existing behavior and interfaces preserved unless explicitly changed
- [ ] No unrelated refactoring
- [ ] Diff inspected for accidental changes

## Verification

List exact commands, results, and exit status.

## Multi-agent limits

- [ ] SDD not used, or entry gate passed
- [ ] No task exceeded 8 files or 300 brief lines
- [ ] No circuit breaker triggered, or trigger documented below

## Remaining risks

State unverified behavior and limitations. Do not write "none" without evidence.
